name: La Dolce Vita  Orient Express
positioning: A luxury train, not a hotel: La Dolce Vita Orient Express travels bespoke itineraries across Italy, with Dimorestudio interiors that pay homage to 1960s Italian design
best_for: Travelers who want to see Italy on a slow luxury train journey with cabins to sleep in on board
Design lovers drawn to 20th-century Italian design
Couples or friends who enjoy aperitivo, live piano and evening music on board

facts.text: La Dolce Vita Orient Express is a luxury train that journeys through many bespoke itineraries across Italy.
The train's aesthetic pays homage to the Italian design legends of the 1960s.
The train was conceived by Dimorestudio, the architecture and design firm established by Emiliano Salci and Britt Moran.
The decor is inspired by the style of Gio Ponti, Nanda Vigo, Gae Aulenti and Osvaldo Borsani.
Guests choose between two cabin categories: Deluxe and Suite Cabins.
Deluxe cabins feature cool colors, mirrored back walls and wooden slat ceilings.
In Deluxe cabins the sofa unfolds into a double bed at night.
Suite cabins are presented as master bedrooms with a sofa and a table with two armchairs.
All Deluxe Cabins and Suites have a private bathroom with shower, toilet and vanity area.
After dinner, guests can enjoy a live show of about an hour and a half.
The reservation includes the transfer to the train station, accommodation, table d'hote meals, beverages, on-board entertainment and applicable taxes.
Some journeys travel one way between Rome and Istanbul.

highlights.text: The La Dolce Vita Suite is arranged in four areas and accommodates up to three guests, with a bedroom with an en suite bathtub and a main bathroom with double sinks and polychrome marbles.
The La Dolce Vita Suite displays artworks on silk crepe created by artist Marta Benet, and its floors alternate wool carpet with Venetian terrazzo.
La Dolce Vita Suite guests have a personal Suite Conductor on board and a private luxury vehicle for transfers to and from the departure and arrival stations.
A pianist is always on board and performs live during aperitivo and through the evening.
At each train stop, a transfer is provided from the arrival station to the city centre.

considerations.text: Children under 12 are not permitted on board.
There are no laundry services or irons on board.
Optional offboard experiences are available at an additional cost.
